name: gui_settings_choose
description: UX-10: the settings a type already says are chosen, not typed. From File > New Project > Blank, gui_build_D's deferred pipeline with its lighting pass and shadow_directional (the same steps), then Features: shadow_directional's Parameters are fields made from its schema -- strength's slider pushed to its end with End, sent at once without Apply, and the shadowed floor changes; pcf_radius's spin takes 2. The KeyLight's direction is an azimuth and an elevation in the Inspector (its colour a swatch): the azimuth turned from -63.43 to 63.43 moves the shadow from the box's left to its right. Rendering settings: material_route_default picked Forward is sent as set_material_route_default and refused by the engine (material_route_unserved@1: this pipeline's only material pass is deferred); the tab says what to do and the field goes back to Auto. Snapshots' + sends one row, named and placed after the opaque pass, without typing; engine FR-1 takes post_ldr as the anchor this graph has, so the row stays, its after picked from snapshot_after_candidates (UX-12b decision 3). The route refusal is one sentence on what to do (decision 5). UX-12b decision 2 (engine FR-2): Features > sky_ambient > Add reads the catalog's insertion and, since neither the composed passes nor the Graph has deferred_lighting, says Place Deferred lighting first before anything is sent; Place in the Graph adds a fullscreen pass of that name with New... open on the Deferred lighting template; Create. Decision 1 (UX-12d, engine FR-3): Add again asks about the targets it needs (lit_color, scene_depth) and, since sky_ambient only reads scene_depth (needs_writer), names the Graph's depth output that will draw it (render_material_pass.depth); Add with targets sends the targets, their references, that output connected to scene_depth_ref and the feature as one edit_batch (decision 2), and it is committed. Decision 4: sky_background draws the sky into lit_color, which nothing reads, so the panel offers Connect lit_color to present: deferred_lighting draws into lit_color and present reads it, as one edit_batch (UX-13d, engine FR-4), so one Edit > Undo Render Edit takes both back and one Redo puts both back; the corner of the viewport turns from black to the sky, and sky_ambient's color_r typed 4 in its Parameters changes it again. Decision 3: cascade_count 3 is refused (shadow_map_ref is declared two_d) and the panel offers Fix: make shadow_map_ref 2D array depth (3 layers); Fix sends the change and, in one graph edit, the target_ref's type and the 2D array port of both lighting passes that read it, as one edit_batch; it is committed and the floor right of the box is still in shadow. Nothing is JSON. Typed: the project folder and the name gsc in New Project, material_pass in the palette's filter (as gui_build_D), and the numbers 2, 63.43, 4 and 3.
